decision_rationale: This is a neural architecture search framework for biological models, not a generative model. The abstract discusses pretrained supernet ranking and downstream transfer, but no decoder, autoregressive, diffusion, or other explicit generative mechanism is described.
evidence_snippet: "introduce BIOARC, a framework utilizing Neural Architecture Search (NAS)" and "predict optimal architectures for new tasks"; "pretrained supernet W"; "12 DNA downstream tasks"; "developing the next generation of efficient biological foundation models"
